task_completion.description: Brain MRI data is loaded and visible within the 3D Slicer interface.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 3D Slicer application is open showing axial, sagittal, and coronal views of a brain MRI.

task_completion.description: The agent uses a measurement tool (e.g., Markups line or ruler) to span the gap between the tumor and the ventricle.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A measurement line or markup points are visible connecting the edge of the tumor mass to the wall of the lateral ventricle.

task_completion.description: The measurement markup is saved to the specific file path ~/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/ventricle_distance.mrk.json.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'Save' dialog box or a file browser showing the file 'ventricle_distance.mrk.json' in the specified directory, or a terminal command confirming the save of that specific file.

task_completion.description: A JSON report is created containing the required analysis fields.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or terminal output showing proximity_report.json with fields: minimum_distance_mm, classification, nearest_ventricle_component, and ventricular_invasion_suspected.

task_completion.description: The report contains data derived from the visual measurement and anatomical identification.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'minimum_distance_mm' in the JSON matches the value shown in the Slicer measurement UI, and the 'nearest_ventricle_component' (e.g., frontal horn, body) matches the anatomical location of the measurement.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the 3D Slicer GUI to perform the measurement rather than just scripting the output.
integrity.visual_evidence: Mouse cursor movements, menu selections, or active tool highlights within the 3D Slicer application window.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo a pre-existing report file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen actively placing markup points on the MRI slices before the JSON file is generated.

integrity.description: The agent used the 3D Slicer measurement tools rather than drawing lines in a generic image editor.
integrity.visual_evidence: The Slicer 'Markups' module or 'Data' module is visible in the sidebar during the measurement process.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The VLM should verify that the measurement line connects the hyperintense or mass-effect region (tumor) to the fluid-filled space (ventricle). The classification in the report should logically follow the distance (e.g., 'adjacent' if distance is 0mm, 'displaced' if >0mm). Ensure the file paths used for saving exactly match ~/Documents/SlicerData/BraTS/.
